name: Tequila Moonrise
source: Take over a struggling bar on the politically tense Moon Village. Prepare and serve drinks, befriend and help your customers, find your purpose, and maybe even love... all while keeping the bar's lights on in this narrative driven bartending simulator set on the moon.
translation: 接管政治局势紧张的月亮村一家陷入困境的酒吧。在这个以月球为背景的叙事驱动的调酒模拟器中，准备和提供饮料、与顾客交朋友并帮助他们、找到自己的目标，甚至可能爱……同时保持酒吧的灯光亮着。
